description: Declarative Table-Driven FSM specification for Kardenwort backend operational mode routing. Defines the complete dispatch table mapping (text_mode, sentences_enabled, dedup_scope) configuration domain states to named pipeline execution strategies. Authoritative source-of-truth for ModeDispatcher conformance and automated cross-platform code generation.

strategies.description: Single-pass monolithic processing pipeline. Processes all words as one contiguous block with global deduplication. Used when sentences mode is disabled or text_mode is single.
Multi-sentence pipeline with per-sentence local deduplication. Each sentence boundary creates an isolated deduplication scope. combine_source_words is always forced to false in this mode.
Multi-sentence pipeline with global combined deduplication across all sentence boundaries. Deduplication operates on the merged word set. combine_source_words is preserved from config.

routing_table.description: Single-mode always routes to MONOLITHIC_LIVE regardless of sentences configuration.
Single-mode always routes to MONOLITHIC_LIVE regardless of sentences configuration.
Multi-mode with sentences disabled routes to MONOLITHIC_LIVE (fallback to single-pass).
Multi-mode with sentences disabled routes to MONOLITHIC_LIVE (fallback to single-pass).
Multi-mode with sentences enabled and sentence-local dedup scope routes to MULTI_SENTENCE_LOCAL_DEDUP.
Multi-mode with sentences enabled and global dedup scope routes to MULTI_GLOBAL_COMBINED.

routing_logic.description: Deterministic dispatch decision tree derived from routing_table above.

decision_tree.condition: text_mode == 'multi' AND sentences_enabled == true AND dedup_scope == 'sentence'
text_mode == 'multi' AND sentences_enabled == true AND dedup_scope != 'sentence'
